content.title: Using LLMs for Cryptocurrency Trade Signal Generation
content.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate structured cryptocurrency trade signals, but valid commands and stable decisions do not necessarily produce profitable trades. We evaluate an implemented signal-generation pipeline through 4,663 model-case-condition evaluations across six experiment families: repeated-call consistency, input representation and model comparisons, setup-selected market cases, input modality, prompt style, and model-specific knowledge-cutoff groups. Models receive historical price and volume tables, indicator-enriched representations, market-structure summaries, or chart
